title: HTTP Configuration
description: Poll HTTP and HTTPS REST APIs and trace their JSON responses

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: HTTP servers to poll. Click 'Add' to add a server, then use Auto-configure to check the servers here.

name.title: Name
name.description: Label this server appears under in the trace and the `server` parameter of the actions. Defaults to the Base URL host (e.g. weather01, 192_168_1_10). Letters, digits, space, '_' or '-'.

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Scheme, host and port, plus any path every request shares, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8080 or https://gateway.local/api. No user name or password: the extension sends no credentials.

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: URL paths polled without a map, each JSON response traced as it comes: /api/sensors traces as event api/sensors, a nested object as a sub-event, an array as fields <key>_0, <key>_1, ...

endpoint_map_file.title: Endpoint Map File
endpoint_map_file.description: JSON endpoint map: named, typed signals picked out of responses by JSON path, and writable setpoints. Optional beside Paths.

poll_interval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
poll_interval.description: How often every path and mapped endpoint is requested, and the _server health event logged

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Request timeout. Empty uses Advanced > Timeout.

verify_tls.title: Verify TLS
verify_tls.description: For https: check the server's certificate and host name. Off: any certificate is accepted, with a WARNING at start.

ca_file.title: CA File
ca_file.description: CA certificates (PEM) that verify this server, instead of the system's: for a private CA or a self-signed server. Empty uses Advanced > CA File.

cert_file.title: Client Certificate
cert_file.description: Client certificate (PEM) for a server that requires one (mutual TLS). Empty uses Advanced > Client Certificate.

key_file.title: Client Private Key
key_file.description: Unencrypted private key (PEM) for the client certificate; empty when the certificate file holds it.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Settings shared by every server, and the defaults a server inherits.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Leading trace source every server publishes under, so events read '<prefix>/<server>/<event>'. Clear it to give each server its own trace source with unprefixed events.

retry_unreachable_at_start.title: Retry Unreachable at Start
retry_unreachable_at_start.description: Off: a server that cannot be reached at start stops the extension. On: it logs an ERROR and is retried like a dropped connection while the other servers poll.

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: Request timeout for every server that leaves its own empty

ca_file.title: CA File
ca_file.description: CA certificates (PEM) that verify every server without its own, instead of the system's.

cert_file.title: Client Certificate
cert_file.description: Client certificate (PEM) every server without its own presents (mutual TLS).

key_file.title: Client Private Key
key_file.description: Unencrypted private key (PEM) for the client certificate; empty when the certificate file holds it.
